description: A React Native component for displaying images from network URLs, local assets, camera roll, or base64 data. Supports resizing, loading states, accessibility, and caching.

data.name: accessible
data.description: Marks the image as an accessibility element.

data.name: accessibilityLabel
data.description: Text read by screen readers when the image is focused.

data.name: alt
data.description: Alternative text for screen readers. Automatically enables accessibility.

data.name: source
data.description: Specifies the image source (remote URL, local asset, or base64).

data.name: resizeMode
data.description: Controls how the image is resized to fit its container.

data.name: blurRadius
data.description: Applies a blur filter to the image.

data.name: tintColor
data.description: Applies a tint color to non-transparent pixels.

data.name: style
data.description: Applies layout, size, border, and transform styles.

data.name: width
data.description: Sets the width of the image.

data.name: height
data.description: Sets the height of the image.

data.name: onLoad
data.description: Called when the image loads successfully.

data.name: onError
data.description: Called when the image fails to load.

data.name: onLoadEnd
data.description: Called when image loading finishes (success or failure).

data.name: resizeMethod
data.description: Controls how image resizing is handled on Android.

methods.name: prefetch
methods.description: Preloads a remote image to cache.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves image width and height before rendering.
methods.signature: Image.getSize(uri: string): Promise<{ width: number, height: number }>

methods.name: queryCache
methods.description: Checks whether images exist in memory or disk cache.

example.title: Basic Image Example
example.description: Displays a remote image with fixed dimensions.

code.snippet:
<Image
  source={{ uri: 'https://reactnative.dev/img/tiny_logo.png' }}
  style={{ width: 100, height: 100 }}
  resizeMode="contain"
/>
